readonly.title: Attention
readonly.msg: This accounting is read-only. The bookings are made in Bexio.

expenseAccount.label: Default expense account
expenseAccount.helper: Account an expense is booked to when no OCR rule matches.

payablesAccount.label: Employee payables account
payablesAccount.helper: Account a reimbursement to an employee is booked against.

fiscalYearStart.label: Start of fiscal year
fiscalYearStart.helper: Month in which the fiscal year starts. 1 = calendar year. Decides which period a booking is assigned to.

receivablesAccount.label: Receivables account
receivablesAccount.helper: Open invoices are booked here until they are paid.

invoiceTemplate.label: Invoice template
invoiceTemplate.helper: Template used to create invoice PDFs.

paymentAccounts.label: Payment accounts
paymentAccounts.helper: An invoice payment may be booked to these accounts.

costCenter.label: Accounting default cost centre
costCenter.helper: Applies to bookings on income and expense accounts without their own default cost centre.

reminderTemplate.label: Reminder template
reminderTemplate.helper: Template used to create payment reminders as PDF.

reminderFeeAccount.label: Reminder fee account
reminderFeeAccount.helper: Reminder fees are booked to this account as income.

reminderFee.helper: Suggested when a reminder is created and can be changed there. 0 = no fee.

reminderGraceDays.label: Grace period (days)
reminderGraceDays.helper: The reminder run suggests an invoice this many days after its due date.

reminderDueDays.label: Payment period of a reminder (days)
reminderDueDays.helper: The receiver has this many days to pay after a reminder.

discountAccount.label: Discount account
discountAccount.helper: Default for new discounts on invoices, e.g. 3800 sales deductions. Empty: the discount reduces the revenue of the items above it, only the net amount is booked.

incomingPaymentLabel.label: Label for incoming payment
incomingPaymentLabel.helper: Shown in booking texts instead of «Zahlungseingang». The stored text stays unchanged. Leave empty to show the word.

outgoingPaymentLabel.label: Label for outgoing payment
outgoingPaymentLabel.helper: Shown in booking texts instead of «Zahlungsausgang». The stored text stays unchanged. Leave empty to show the word.

deletePosition.confirm: Do you really want to delete this position? This cannot be undone.

key.label: Short code
key.helper: A short internal code for this position. It helps you recognize it in lists and reports.

usage.label: Usage
usage.helper: What this position is for, for example a membership fee or an admission fee.

type.label: Calculation type
type.helper: How the amount of this position is calculated, for example as a fixed amount.

label.label: Label
label.helper: The text a member sees for this position on their invoice.

source.label: Source of the amount
source.helper: Decides where the amount of this position comes from: a category price list, a flag, a rule, or entered by you by hand.

categoryList.label: Category price list
categoryList.helper: Each member pays the price of their category from this list. Your club's own list is preset; choose another one only for a special case such as the SRV fee.

flag.label: Flag
flag.helper: The member flag that triggers this position, for example a locker. Only needed when the source is 'Flag'.

rule.label: Rule
rule.helper: The stored rule that triggers this position, for example joining at over 25. Only needed when the source is 'Rule'.

amount.label: Amount
amount.helper: The amount in francs for this position.

accountKey.label: Booking account
accountKey.helper: The account this position is booked to.

vatCodeKey.label: VAT code
vatCodeKey.helper: The VAT code that applies to this position.

proRata.label: Pro rata (by months of membership)
proRata.helper: In the year of joining and of leaving, only the months of membership are charged, rounded to whole francs.

voucher.title: Vouchers
voucher.loadError: The vouchers could not be loaded. Please try again later.

validation.reminderFeeDecimals: Please enter the amount with at most two decimal places.
validation.reminderFeeAccountRequired: Reminder fees need a revenue account. Choose one or set all fees to 0.

ledger.loadError: The bookings could not be loaded. Please try again later.
